description: Fetches author profile data from Google Scholar (scholar.google.com) including citation statistics, publications, and co-authors.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_author_profile: 获取作者完整档案，包括统计信息、发表列表和合作者；需要 user_id; 参数: user_id, max_publications; 必填: user_id
  - get_publications: 仅获取作者的发表列表；需要 user_id; 参数: user_id, max_publications; 必填: user_id

user_id.description: Google Scholar 用户 ID，来自 citations?user=XXX 参数

max_publications.description: 返回的最大发表数量，默认 100
